items.title: 18.10.3 Reaction Between Copper(II) Ion and Iodide Ion (copper(II) ion aur iodide ion ka reaction) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.10.3 with Quick Check 18.8, printed page 31.

blocks.text: Copper(II) sulphate ke solution mein zyada (excess) potassium iodide dalne par yeh reaction hota hai:
Yeh reaction in half-equations mein bat jata hai:
Aam tor par zyada E° wala I₂/I⁻ couple reduce hona chahiye. Cu²⁺/Cu⁺ couple ka E° kam hai, jo batata hai ke Cu⁺ I⁻ se behtar reducing agent hai.
Phir bhi poora reaction aage chalta hai, halan ke hisaab se net standard potential negative aata hai: likhe gaye reaction ke liye E°cell = 0.15 − 0.54 = −0.39 V.

Reaction is liye aage chalta hai ke banne wala CuI lagataar solution se precipitate ho kar neeche baith jata hai. Is se product Cu⁺ solution se nikal jata hai aur equilibrium daen taraf khisak jata hai (Le Chatelier's principle). Is reaction mein banne wali I₂ ka amount (miqdar) thiosulfate solution se titration kar ke maloom ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Iodine ki measurement (paimaish)
blocks.text: Titration ka reaction: I₂ + 2S₂O₃²⁻ → 2I⁻ + S₄O₆²⁻. Starch indicator ka neela rang ghayab hone par end point aata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Standard electrode potentials (E°) se redox reaction ki feasibility tay karne ka principle (usool) batayein.
blocks.explanation: E°cell = E°reduction − E°oxidation nikalein; agar E°cell positive ho to reaction feasible hai. Zyada positive E° wali species reduce hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) MnO₄⁻/Mn²⁺ (E° = +1.52 V) aur Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ (E° = +0.77 V) ke reaction mein oxidizing aur reducing agent batayein.
blocks.explanation: MnO₄⁻ oxidizing agent hai (reduce ho kar Mn²⁺); Fe²⁺ reducing agent hai (oxidize ho kar Fe³⁺).

blocks.prompt: c) MnO₄⁻ aur C₂O₄²⁻ ke reaction ka E°cell nikalte waqt paani kyun shamil nahi hota, halan ke balanced equation mein hai?
blocks.explanation: E°cell sirf do standard electrode potentials se nikalta hai, jo pehle hi standard conditions mein poori half-equations ke liye hain; paani solvent hai, us ka amount taqreeban constant rehta hai, aur woh alag se hisaab mein nahi aata.

items: CuI ka precipitate Cu⁺ ko hata kar reaction aage chalata hai (Le Chatelier).
I₂ thiosulfate se titrate hoti hai.
